enrichment.summary: This adds money for Bay Area Community Resources to expand FabLab services before and after school at Rudsdale Continuation High School, because enrollment and student interest in technology courses rose. It serves 30 to 50 more students, for a total of 175 for the year. It adds $11,500, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $71,932.50 to $83,432.50, with the term (September 1, 2022 through May 31, 2023) unchanged.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Mindful Life Project up to $10,000 for mindfulness assemblies at East Oakland Pride Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district is paying Mindful Life Project to hold monthly mindfulness, mindful hip-hop and social-emotional learning assemblies at East Oakland Pride Elementary School. It also provides staff training on mindfulness in the classroom, plus ongoing coaching and demonstration lessons. The agreement runs September 1, 2022 through June 23, 2023, at up to $10,000, and the board is approving it after work began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $28,800 for We Lead Ours student support services at Roosevelt Middle School
enrichment.summary: This adds services from We Lead Ours for about 25 more students at Roosevelt Middle School. The services include emotional regulation, strengths-based assessments, restorative justice and anger management for students referred to its caseload. It adds $28,800, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $28,800 to $57,600, with the term (September 1, 2022 through May 31, 2023) unchanged.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Attitudinal Healing Connection up to $24,960 for art workshops and an ArtMobile visit at Reach Academy
enrichment.summary: The district is paying Attitudinal Healing Connection for a professional development workshop, art kits for each student, and a week-long visit from the ArtMobile, a trailer built for outdoor art experiences, at Reach Academy. The activities are built around themes celebrating the Reach community and the Principles of Attitudinal Healing. The agreement runs April 10 through May 25, 2023, at up to $24,960, and began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $7,200 for clinical supervision of counseling interns serving district students
enrichment.summary: This adds 72 hours of clinical supervision for interns who provide clinical services to district students, so they can meet the requirements of their social work and family therapy internship placements. The contractor is an individual. It adds $7,200, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $36,000 to $43,200, with the term (August 15, 2022 through May 31, 2023) unchanged. The board is approving it after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,325 for Center for the Collaborative Classroom teacher coaching at three schools
enrichment.summary: This adds in-school consulting, virtual professional development and coaching from the Center for the Collaborative Classroom to prepare teachers to use the Caring School Community curriculum at Sankofa Academy, Montclair Elementary School and Crocker Highlands Elementary School. It adds $5,325, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $3,500 to $8,825, with the term (February 1 through October 31, 2023) unchanged. The board is approving it after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $10,950 for teacher training on a student mural project at Elmhurst United Middle School
enrichment.summary: This adds a service in which the contractor, an individual, leads professional development for a team of teachers who will organize and lead a student mural project at Elmhurst United Middle School. It adds $10,950, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $31,775 to $42,725, with the term (August 3, 2022 through May 25, 2023) unchanged. The board is approving it after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays a contractor up to $20,000 to connect LIFE Academy students to summer programs
enrichment.summary: The district is paying an individual contractor to run workshops in all LIFE Academy advisories on available summer programs, reaching all high school students. Goals include having 80% of students in grades 9-11 apply to a summer program and 40% connected to science programs, meeting with families, and tracking results. The agreement runs May 1 through June 30, 2023, at up to $20,000, and the board is approving it after work began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Blueprint Schools Network up to $73,500 for its Math Fellows Program at Elmhurst United
enrichment.summary: The district is paying Blueprint Schools Network to run a Math Fellows Program at Elmhurst United Middle School. The program aims to build the mathematical foundation and critical reasoning skills students need for success in college and beyond. The agreement runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, at up to $73,500, and the board is approving it after work began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Blueprint Schools Network - Elmhurst United Middle School

enrichment.headline: Pays Public Health Institute up to $14,500 for Castlemont's Health Equity Academy
enrichment.summary: The district is paying Public Health Institute to continue work on the Health Equity Academy at Castlemont High School, a pathway for students into public health careers. Tasks include student leadership development, event support, staff support and curriculum and career pathway support. The agreement runs February 1 through June 30, 2023, at up to $14,500, and the board is approving it after work began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: This adds well-being and academic progress services from East Bay Agency for Children for about 25 more students at Roosevelt Middle School, using its existing wellness models. It adds $48,000, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $5,428.57 to $53,428.57, with the term (September 1, 2022 through May 26, 2023) unchanged.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district is accepting a $22,500 grant from the Quest Foundation, passed through the Oakland Public Education Fund, to pay the salary of the art teacher at Think College Now Elementary School. The grant covers February 18, 2023 through May 31, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $1.3M Stupski Foundation grant to support college and career access for high schoolers
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting $1,300,000 from the Stupski Foundation. The money supports building collaborative systems, professional development and spaces among college and career access organizations, to serve all Oakland Unified high school students. It runs through the High School Linked Learning Office from March 1, 2023 through February 29, 2028.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Safe Passages of Oakland will run outreach to families, family engagement events and student engagement activities at Coliseum College Preparatory Academy. The work is part of the Joyful Schools piece of the California Community Schools Partnership Program (CCSPP) plan to reconnect students and families after the pandemic. The agreement covers April 1 through June 30, 2023, a start date before the Board vote, and is paid from a CCSPP implementation grant.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: We Lead Ours of Oakland will work with students, through the Oakland Athletic League, in hands-on activities led by coaches, college and career preparation workshops, weekly field trips and team projects. The agreement runs April 1 through July 28, 2023, a start date before the Board vote, and is paid from carryover funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board is approving two tentative agreements with the Service Employees International Union (SEIU), Local 1021: a revised memorandum of understanding on safety training dated January 3, 2023, and a memorandum of understanding on a City of Oakland Affordable Connectivity Plan pilot. No dollar amounts are stated. Approval depends on meeting state public-disclosure requirements and any follow-up actions set by the Alameda County Office of Education.

enrichment.headline: Leases portable buildings from Mobile Modular for $1.02M for Roosevelt Middle School
enrichment.summary: Mobile Modular Management Corporation will design, supply and install 13 classroom portables, one administrative portable and one restroom portable for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. It will also get the permits and meet Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements. The $1,024,427 total includes up to $75,000 for an owner's contingency allowance and up to $44,893 for additive alternates (optional extras). Work is scheduled from June 8, 2023 to January 20, 2027, paid from the Measure Y building fund.

enrichment.headline: Awards Mar Con Builders $6.55M for Kaiser Child Development Center campus improvements
enrichment.summary: Mar Con Builders, Inc. of Oakland will replace the play area and play structures to build an outdoor learning and play area, replace paving next to the school, install new turf and replace the fire alarm throughout the existing building. The $6,551,440 total includes a $260,000 contingency allowance, and Mar Con was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder. Work is expected to start June 8, 2023 and finish by November 4, 2023.

enrichment.summary: Rook Electric of Oakland will maintain security cameras at sites across the district, including fixture repairs, for 12 months. It was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder. Work starts June 8, 2023 and ends June 7, 2024, paid from Measure B building funds.
